scope: L1I-CORE-OPERAND-CUT: break sys_clk_50 setup long chain from core idex_d.operand_a through ALU/forwarding/decode/fetch-control to I-L1 rsp_data_r enable; keep fetch/I-cache/coherence semantics.

implementation.summary: Removed ID/EX ordinary GPR ALU writeback combinational forwarding from gprv. Added ex_id_gpr_hazard to stall an IF/ID instruction that depends on an ID/EX non-load non-STXR GPR write; the result is provided one cycle later from the EX/MEM registered forwarding path. Added the same hazard to fetch_fifo_pop so the F1a FIFO does not pop a head while IF/ID is stalled. flush_id also suppresses branch/system redirects until the registered EX/MEM operand is available. No SDC false path, no cache/coherence/async-reset change.

semantics.architecture_state: unchanged; only pipeline timing of ordinary GPR RAW dependencies changes
semantics.commit_order: unchanged; p2 and hazard difftest match QEMU
semantics.speculation: no new speculative execution; existing control-flow fence/flush still determines redirects
